summarize_model_config: summarize the MAE ViT-B/16 pretrain model configuration dictionary and its backbone, neck, and head settings
review_mae_config: review the MAE model config for backbone arch, mask ratio, decoder depth, and loss settings
build_mae_model: build an MAE pretrain model using the ViT-B/16 backbone config with 75% mask ratio
refactor_mae_config: refactor the MAE model config to change the mask ratio or decoder embedding dimensions
test_mae_config: test the MAE ViT-B/16 config by instantiating the model dict and verifying all required keys
